title: Multiple end spawn platform
description: Introduces 1:1 distance between the coordinates in the overworld and in the end.
body:
This mod was made for my Minecraft server to teleports entity to the same coordinates as the end portal.

No configuration needed!

## Why did I made this mod?
Well is because I think this feature for my minecraft server is really good for my players, as it allows them to have multiple sand dupers on the server, so everybody can dupe sand.
